takes.prompt: The same blonde guitarist plays a continuous rock rhythm phrase around118BPM, repeatedly making short natural down-up picking/strumming strokes with her RIGHT wrist over the bridge/pickups while her LEFT fingers press and release nearby frets in several coherent chord changes. Her left thumb stays behind the neck, strap supports the black cream-bound six-string single-cut guitar and both arms stay causally connected. Small grounded shoulder/weight/hair response accompanies the repeated hand action. Preserve six tuning machines, two humbuckers, round neutral flower ornament, blonde face and asymmetric black lace outfit. Detailed hand-drawn anime style and a steady camera. Preserve face, hair, costume, natural finger count, connected wrists/arms and supported instruments. Performance movement must continue throughout rather than a camera move, held pose or single slow flourish. The steady rock pulse around118BPM is art direction, not a claim of exact note/beat sync. No extra figures, duplicated limbs, instrument morphing, or source-frame looping.
